reason: Assertion PASS/PASS means only that an XStreamException occurred and callbacks stayed zero. ConversionException cause is absent; this is not evidence of advisory mitigation. A bounded fixture must first demonstrate successful proxy construction and a harmless callback on before, record the exception cause and conversion stage, then evaluate the same input/oracle on after with any security configuration stated explicitly and ordinary controls passing. The pinned patch's setupSecurity adds AnyTypePermission.ANY; new permission APIs alone do not prove default rejection. Map the result to the actual caller and affected callable. No shell execution is needed. Version 1.4.10, JSON and other gadget chains are outside this pair.
